## Lasher Scallop (CR 1/2)

**XP** 200  
N Small animal () (aquatic)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision, darkvision; Perception +2  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +2 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 10 (1d8+2)  
**Fort** +5 **Ref** +6 **Will** +2  
**Defensive Abilities** shell retreat  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft.  
**Melee** 5 tentacles +3 (1d3+3 plus grab)  
**Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 11, **Dex** 17, **Con** 14, **Int** 2, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 3  
**Base Atk** +0; **CMB** +3 (+8 grapple); **CMD** 13 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +17, Climb +4, Stealth +19; Racial Modifiers +10 Acrobatics, +8 Stealth  
**SQ** amphibious  


**Special Abilities**


**Shell Retreat (Ex)** Lasher scallops can withdraw into their shells completely, increasing their natural armor bonus to +5 but decreasing their speed to 0.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate caves and forest roots  
**Organization** solitary, or rout (4-7)  
**Treasure** standard
